plugins.name: luxvance
plugins.description: Luxvance internal toolkit. Brand voice and visual identity, Notion task creation, campaign intelligence analysis with locked-hypothesis handoff, build-campaign production engineer that ships a 9-block paste-ready kit for Clay and Instantly (campaign brief, rendered email, Sculpture filters, Variable prompts, subject and body spintax), discovery-call booking with the Luxvance calendar conventions, make-invoice that renders branded AED invoices for the client roster (CapQuest, Kcal, GFV) with Stripe and ZATCA blocks where applicable, and cleanup-completed-campaigns that frees Instantly contact-quota by removing no-reply leads from finished or paused campaigns while preserving every replier. Client Intelligence Library sync (Notion to Supabase) runs as an automated Render cron, not as a skill.
